description.value: PrinkleChicken is a Korean-style fried chicken franchise with multiple Vancouver-area locations, serving hand-battered, deep-fried chicken brushed with a range of Korean sauces including yangyeom, honey, and padak padak. The Kingsway location is one of roughly ten outlets across the Lower Mainland and Vancouver Island. The menu also features cheese balls, tteokbokki, and shrimp, making it a solid quick-service stop for a hungry cyclist along the Kingsway corridor.
